summary.text: Paul Tittl is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 25, who took office on January 7, 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Christopher Able.

paragraphs.text: Tittl won Assembly District 25 general elections in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

For 2025-2026 his committee assignments include chairing the Mental Health Committee and serving as vice-chair of the Sporting Heritage Committee, along with seats on the Campaigns and Elections, Corrections, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation, and Veterans and Military Affairs committees.
